text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(――A freezing wind is leaking out.
From a dark, dark, hollow abyss.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I will keep filling it in.
Forcing my frozen limbs to move.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so fast! And that form is completely flawless...
Who is that... running over there?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, that one is scheduled to debut this year...
Admire Groove, I believe.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove... A few years ago,
she swept through all the prestigious junior racesâ

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove, the "child prodigy"...! 
I see...! Finally...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
*pant*......... *pant*.........
I can still... get faster.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Coming out of the corner...
I should be able to shift my center of gravity back a little faster...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Next time... I'll do better...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(—Think, then train. Repeat the process.
Until I achieve the desired results.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Strength is... something acquired in that manner.)

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Alv-senpai is just in a different league...
Honestly, I'm glad she's not in our generation...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
If only I could emulate that talent and motivation...
...Then I could live up to my hometown's expectations, too.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, gotcha. My parents are really looking forward to my
debut too... Talk about mega pressure...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...I read it in a book once: "In this world, only two kinds of entities exist: 'myself' and 'others'"... it said.)

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a "prodigy."
She really does draw envious gazes, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me, reporter? Is there something you need?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text: Aren't you going to offer some guidance to your lost juniors?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I am not a mentor.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I have no intention of playing nice with anyone.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha, truly a solitary athlete.
Please allow me to officially interview you after your debut.
Until then—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Making up excuses for what I can't do, and unconsciously seeking agreement from my peers...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Familiarity breeds complacency.
Complacency leads to compromise, and compromise hinders growth.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
("Others" won't elevate "you."
The only one who can make you stronger... is yourself.)

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
To bring out a trainee's full potential, I truly believe
a 'bond of trust' is absolutely essential!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's true. I'm taking charge of most of their active career.
I gotta be someone they can rely on more than anyone else!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Some time has passed since I became Admire Groove's trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From a conventional standpoint, my colleagues' point about
the importance of building trust makes total sense, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If we limit the scope strictly to being Admire Groove's trainer, that might not necessarily be the case.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —There is no need.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Counseling is not part of
a trainer's job duties, is it?
choice_data_list: I'm not going to force you, but... if anything comes up, let me know, alright?
I'm not forcing you or anything, but... if anything comes up, let me know, okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Even if I did have personal worries, I have no intention of discussing them.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: That's the kind of relationship we're supposed to have.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Beyond the information necessary to fulfill our "contract,"
we have no need to know anything about each other.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Please make sure you do not forget the terms of our trainer contract.
choice_data_list: —"No meddling in each other's business," huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That was her stance against unnecessary socializing,
and one of the conditions of our Trainer contract."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Could you start the meeting?
I'd rather not waste any time."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: What I currently require of you, Trainer, is the design of an efficient, lean, and logically sound training regimen...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Based on the analysis of your growth rate, we will calculate the appropriate load and adjust it accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: All of that is—
choice_data_list: It's for next year's Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...That is correct.
The Oka Sho, the Oaks, the Shuka Sho...
To conquer them all—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Our contract is...
solely to accomplish that single objective.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It's only a temporary contract, just for a brief moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—She seeks nothing beyond the absolute bare minimum interaction with a Trainer.
No, rather than simply not seeking it, it borders on rejection.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even with such a distorted contractual relationship,
the reason I became her Trainer was—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Lies in the sense of precariousness I feel towards her,
as she stubbornly keeps her distance from others.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Gh...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Stop it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Please, don't reach out your hand to me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Accepting "support"...
means giving up on "overcoming it alone"...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (I refuse to accept—such a way of living.)

text_block_list.name: Kids' School Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Which school is that winner from!?
She's unaffiliated—does that mean she's self-taught!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I'll become strong, win, and live on my own.
I don't need... anyone's support.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going to go for a run outside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A familiar Umamusume spoke to me.
It was Neo Universe, who debuted in the same year as Admire Groove.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove's soul is... wandering. Still adrift within the fluctuations of... "loss" and "repair".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"In order not to become "LOST"...
"Repair" of "CONT" is required—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There's a sense that she has had her eye on Admire Groove for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words are so abstract that I can only vaguely get the gist,
so I'm not sure if my interpretation is correct, but—
choice_data_list: It's okay. I'll be there to support Alv

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Then, Neo Universe will...
make a "wish" too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What could it be?
choice_data_list: Let's extend the interval a bit.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Your concern is... unnecessary...
choice_data_list: Longer intervals are important for muscle hypertrophy, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: ...When it comes to training, I want you to trust me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ……Understood.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I've rested enough now... so let's resume.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The solitary Umamusume continues to run today
without uttering a single complaint.
All to win the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hide my true feelings from her solitary self
and support her along her solitary path.
So she won't have to fight alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With differing motives in mind, the story of our journey
toward the Twinkle Series begins――
